title: Higher moments of the symmetric square $L$-function off the critical line
summary: Let $f$ be the Hecke eigenform for the modular group $SL_2(\mathbb{Z})$, and $L(s, \text{sym}^2 f)$ be the symmetric square $L$-function associated with $f$.
